# Sources and evidence classes

Doctrine 0.1.0. Sources marked unpublished (owner notes, design papers, a course synthesis) cannot be checked by a reader; they are cited so the trail is complete.

| class | meaning |
|---|---|
| research | Peer-reviewed or university-course evidence. Cite the study; keep its context (cultivar, substrate, light). |
| vendor | A nutrient, substrate or controller vendor's published guidance or trial. Useful defaults, not proof. |
| grower-practice | Practitioner synthesis (the GrowLabs wiki, the crop-steering advisor notes). Consistent with research where cited, otherwise experience. |
| product-rule | What this software does or must do: the engine's decide(), the controller's gates, the brain contract. Never contradicted by advice. |
